sections.title: I. Choose the correct answer A, B, or C to fill in each blank in the following passage.
sections.introHtml:
I live in a village in the north of Viet Nam. Every day, like most of my friends, I walk to school. It is three kilometers (1) ________ . After class, I often help my mother to collect water from the river and feed the chickens. At the weekend, the villagers often (2) ________ at the community hall where there is a TV. The adults watch TV, but more often they talk about their farm work and exchange news. The children run around, playing games and shouting (3) ________. Laughter is heard everywhere.

My father sometimes takes me to the market town nearby where he sells our home products like vegetables, fruits, eggs… he then buys me (4) ________ ice cream and lets me take a ride on the electric train in the town square. I love those trips. On starry (5) ________, children lie on the grass, looking at the sky and daring each other to find the Milky Way. We dream of faraway places.

sections.title: II. Read the following passage and answer the questions.
sections.introHtml: Social media has become a big part of teenagers' lives today. Many teens spend hours online each day, chatting with friends, sharing pictures, or watching videos. While social media allows them to stay connected, it can also cause stress. For example, some teens feel pressure to post pictures that look perfect or get many likes and comments. This can make them anxious if their posts don't get the response they want. Additionally, too much time spent on social media can take away from other important activities, such as doing homework or spending time with family. Despite these challenges, many teenagers find social media to be a fun and creative outlet where they can express themselves and keep in touch with people from around the world.
